notes.title: v1.07 Save system update
notes.notes: Updated the game progress and settings file save system to address conflicts if multiple Steam accounts are used on the same Windows/Linux/Steamdeck system regardless of if Steam cloud save is enabled. Now a user can change settings in their game and it won't affect settings in another user's installation of the game.

notes.title: Update 1.05c Custom Level Slots Increase Update
notes.notes:
Due to popular demand, I have increased the number of save slots for custom levels, as well as optimized filesize for custom levels to accommodate the larger capacity for saved levels.  Additional improvements have been made, listed below:

[*] Custom level slots increased from 50 to 1000 with page selection
[*] Optimized filesize for custom levels - from 15kb down to 3-4kb per level
[*] Custom levels can now be named manually on PC and Linux or automatically when importing/exporting levels on PC, Linux and Steamdeck
[*] Additional UI elements added to provide clarity on gamepad controls for going back a screen, paging on custom level selection, and moving player and exit within the editor
[*] Sprite for "1" redrawn for consistency of design and width of other pixelart numbers
[*] Numbers on level select buttons now move with button when pressed
[*] Level 6 has been altered to remove an unintended shortcut
[*] Dev/par scores have been rebalanced for various levels

notes.title: Update v1.02c: New Feature - Allow floating boxes in custom levels
notes.notes:
In the classic DOS game Block-man by Soleau Software, there were secret levels which had blocks that would hover until they have been picked up, which made for some interesting puzzles.  I've implemented that feature in the latest update, so boxes placed in the air in the level editor will no longer fall as soon as the level is played.  Feel free to try this new feature out and upload your custom maps to https://www.moddb.com/games/super-retro-boxbot.

Thanks!

[*] Implemented floating boxes - Boxes placed in the air in custom levels remain airborne until picked up

notes.title: Major Update: Multiple undo states (500), Removed move penalty
notes.notes:
You can now undo you last 500 actions (moving, falling, taking elevators, picking up/placing boxes, etc.), making the game much more accessible.  In addition, I've removed the move penalty for using the rewind or undo features.  These, along with some minor bugfixes, should make the game more enjoyable.  Please let me know if you have any questions, concerns or suggestions.

Thanks!
Joseph Holliday
Manager, Doc Holliday Games LLC
